scope: Five unique purpose-specific PNG exteriors, larger human-scaled buildings, separated districts, catalog-based habitat/greenhouse, shared routes and collision, upward-facing path mesh correction
measurement_limits: Apple M5, native Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility, 60 FPS cap, 270 process-frame intervals; not GPU timing, improvement claim, or qualification of 50 unique images. Includes the whole colony.
limitations: Habitat and greenhouse are decorative exteriors without playable rooms or operational bindings.
Fixed-camera billboards retain independent approximate ground collision; no arbitrary-angle volumes, animated doors or whole-building shadows.
50-host fixture shares one artwork; no distinct-50-image memory qualification.
Local resource pack verified; no signed application, web export or cluster deployment performed.
retained_failures: Opaque reference-guided generations rejected before integration; accepted raw PNGs pass alpha checks.
